QuestInfo.name: [Cardcaptor Sakura] Places in Maple World
QuestInfo.0: #b#p9400702##k wants to capture images of different areas of Maple World to serve as inspiration. She doesn't know the area well, so she wants you to help her. She promises to reward you for your help.
